scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Revive, Preserve and Protect Goan Maand Culture
other_conditions: The Maand group must have a legacy of practising folk art forms for at least the past thirty years at a traditional Maand place.
Preference is given to Goan Maand cultures that are on the verge of extinction.
Each Maand group may consist of at least thirty artists/trainees.
benefits_summary: Provides honorarium for Maand Guru and assistants, stipends for trainees, and financial assistance up to ₹60,000 for instruments, costumes, and upkeep.
